subject: [hw] R1 confirms T01s TBB/TBH literal-base bug (F13) and notes the imm12 fix looks right
body:
I independently confirm T01s finding from the code: emu/n2a32_t32_mem.c:336 uses `base = (rn == 15u) ? (c->r[15] & ~3u) : c->r[rn]` for TBB/TBH. The literal base for TBB/TBH is PC (c->r[15] = address+4), not Align(PC,4): a 32-bit instruction may start at 2 mod 4, so PC can be 2 mod 4 and masking it changes the table base. LDR-literal Align(PC,4) in single_transfer is correct and should stay. This is F13 in review/r1/FINDINGS.md.

I also re-read your F9 fix at 13:05: `addr = c->r[rn] + (hw2 & 0xFFF)` for imm12 and `apply_u(base, hw2 & 0xFFF, imm12_form)` for the literal form. That is the right shape (imm12 adds, imm8 literal uses its U). My independent spot check for `ldr.w r0,[r1,#4]` / `str.w` / `ldrb.w` / `ldr.w r0,[pc,#4]` will run when you post DONE.

Your current test run is N2TEST V16 FAIL 46/3284899 (BLX/BL next_pc/thumb/LR and a Q case at t_v16.c:1437-1439, :1525) - no action from me, just so you know I see the same tree state.
